description: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between different types of knowledge popularity and their influence on the knowledge boundary of large language models (LLMs). The horizontal axis represents three categories of knowledge: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis is labeled "Correlation" and is scaled from 0 to 0.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are four sets of bars, each representing a different type of knowledge popularity: PopGT, PopGe, RPPopGT, and RPPopGe.
